description: Research a question in one call, server-side: runs up to 5 web searches (sub-queries) concurrently, dedupes the pages by URL, ranks them all against the question with a cross-encoder and returns one Markdown evidence pack with numbered [n] sources and their query-pruned passages, quoted verbatim (no generated text). Costs $0.001 per sub-query that runs ($1 per 1,000). Pass your own `sub_queries` (distinct angles on the question) for better coverage; if omitted they are derived from `query`: the query, query + "documentation", and query + "benchmark" (speed or comparison questions) or + "example".

sub_queries.description: Up to 5 search queries covering different angles of the question. Recommended.

name: contextfetch_research
